text:
Root cause: `flag_value` was only inferred when `type` was omitted. With an explicit type, it remained `None`, so the parser stored `None` when the flag was passed.

Changed `Option` initialization to infer the flag value independently of type selection. Explicitly typed flags now use the opposite of their default as the flag value, which is then converted by the declared type. Relevant tests pass.

final_text:
Root cause: `flag_value` was only inferred when `type` was omitted. With an explicit type, it remained `None`, so the parser stored `None` when the flag was passed.

Changed `Option` initialization to infer the flag value independently of type selection. Explicitly typed flags now use the opposite of their default as the flag value, which is then converted by the declared type. Relevant tests pass.
